column1: # What each page version must do in the Mac harness (read by check-results.py).
# starter and solution come straight from the pages (Chapter9, Chapter10, Chapter11) (solution = the answer-key page);
# every other version is variants/<page>/<name>.swift under the page's real hidden code.
# fallback-* versions prove the first-line rule: a page function whose first line differs from the
# one the engine looks for (or a missing one) quietly falls back to the built-in, and the checks
#   version   checks: ✅/❌ per check in order ("-" = page has no checks)
#   hint      text the first ❌ hint must contain ("-" = no hint expected)
#   bot       complete = the bot finishes the page in at least 1 of the seeds
#             none     = the page is never completed (a ❌ check blocks the 🚩, or the level can't be beaten)
#   fuzz      gate       = 500 random-input runs: the 🚩 is never reached unlocked and never completed
#   warn      text the panel's "⚠️ The engine can't find your ..." line must contain while the bot plays
